location_exception_reason: Container Homes are manufactured products with nationwide distribution and installation capability; location in title is seller logistics, not a buyer decision factor. Buyers select based on BHK, container size, finish, and delivery scope — not origin city.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Exporter) are redundant in Container Home titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. The product is a container home regardless of who manufactures or supplies it.
